messages.content: List exactly 3 benefits of unit tests as bullet points, each line starting with "- ". Output only the three bullet lines and nothing else.
Explain what a hash map is in at most 40 words.
Describe the ocean in exactly two sentences. Do not use the words "blue", "water" or "wave" (or their plurals).
Reply with only the word OK in uppercase letters, with no punctuation and nothing else.
Write a title for a blog post about memory safety in Rust. The title must be written entirely in capital letters, contain at most 8 words, and contain no colon. Output only the title.
Give exactly 4 numbered steps for making a cup of tea, formatted as "1. ...", "2. ..." and so on. After the steps, write a final line containing exactly: DONE
Always answer in Spanish, whatever language the user writes in.
What are two advantages of electric cars? Keep it short.
